messages:
Jada Williams: heads up — instrumentation bug found post-launch. `first_streaming_success` is firing on stream open (SSE connect) not on first token, and we’re also missing `model` on `first_request_success` for some requests. This is going to mess with activation + email triggers. Can we hotfix today?

SentryBot: :rotating_light: Analytics schema validation warnings spiking
- event: first_request_success
- error: missing required property "model"
- sample_user_id: 8f3c***
- env: prod

Logan Wright: confirmed. saw a bunch of payloads hitting the collector with `model: undefined` (looks like server-side event emitter path). also the streaming one is definitely wrong trigger; it’s using `onOpen` not `onFirstToken`.

Paula Mendes: +1, this is impacting our sprint primary metric. dashboard slice for “activated via streaming” jumped overnight and it doesn’t match token usage. need to fix + annotate.

Jin Woo Park: I can take the hotfix. two changes:
1) server: plumb `model` (and `route_id` while we’re there) into `first_request_success` from the resolved request context
2) console: move `first_streaming_success` emission to when we receive the first `delta` chunk (or whatever we call it in the stream parser)

Chloe Martin: please do. keep it minimal + behind the existing analytics schema check so we don’t regress. what’s the fastest patch path — can we land directly to main + deploy?

Jin Woo Park: yup. I’ll open PR in ~30.

Sean Gallagher: quick note: if you’re touching stream parsing, pls sanity check it doesn’t add per-chunk overhead. we’re tight on console perf budget. also make sure we don’t double-fire event on reconnect.

Leila Farouk: I can QA in staging + prod canary once the build is out. can you share reproduction steps / expected event props?

Logan Wright: expected per taxonomy:
- `first_request_success`: { user_id, project_id, route_id, model, sdk, http_status, request_kind }
- `first_streaming_success`: same + `stream_protocol` (sse/ws) and should fire once per user (first time ever)
current bad behavior:
- `first_streaming_success` fires even if stream disconnects before any tokens
- `first_request_success` missing `model` when request goes through /v1/chat/completions with default model resolution

Jada Williams: for QA: create new test user in staging, create key, do a streaming call that you immediately cancel before tokens — should NOT fire success. then do one that returns at least 1 token — should fire.

Leila Farouk: got it. also we should verify dedupe logic doesn’t fire again on page refresh.

DeployBot: build #142881 queued for branch hotfix/events-streaming-success

Jin Woo Park: PR up: “Hotfix: correct streaming success trigger + include model in first_request_success”. Changes:
- server emitter now pulls `resolvedModelId` from request context and maps to `model`
- streaming success moved from `onStreamOpen()` to `onFirstToken()` in stream client
- added guard: only fire if `received_token_count > 0` and not previously fired for user+project

Sean Gallagher: can you paste the exact guard condition? want to make sure it’s not relying on localstorage only.

Jin Woo Park: sure:
```ts
if (!hasFired("first_streaming_success", projectId) && firstTokenAtMs && receivedTokenCount > 0) {
  emit(...)
  markFired("first_streaming_success", projectId)
}
```
markFired is localstorage + also server-side dedupe via the events pipeline (same user+project+event_name within 7d)

Logan Wright: localstorage is fine as extra, but server dedupe is what we’ll trust. pls ensure `project_id` included in payload; some older clients omit it.

Jin Woo Park: yep included.

Chloe Martin: approving pending QA. Leila — can you run through staging asap once deploy is ready? we need this before end of day given growth emails are using `first_streaming_success` as a branch.

Leila Farouk: on it. also can we add a quick unit test to prevent regression? at least one for “cancel before token => no event”.

Jin Woo Park: added a small test for the stream parser callback + event emission. not full e2e but covers the trigger.

Paula Mendes: once shipped, can we tag the time window of bad data? I need to inform Sana/Mei for the readout. approximate start time was launch yesterday ~10am PT.

Jada Williams: I’ll post in #product + update tracker once we have exact deploy time. also we may need to rerun activation calc excluding `first_streaming_success` before fix.

DeployBot: staging deploy complete for web-console @ 2026.02.25-rc3

Leila Farouk: staging QA results:
- streaming call cancelled before tokens: no `first_streaming_success` emitted :white_check_mark:
- streaming call w/ tokens: event emitted once, includes `model`, `route_id`, `project_id`, `stream_protocol: sse` :white_check_mark:
- refresh page + stream again: no second fire :white_check_mark:
- non-stream 2xx call: `first_request_success` now includes `model` :white_check_mark:

Sean Gallagher: perf quick check? any noticeable increase in handler time?

Leila Farouk: I spot-checked with devtools perf — no obvious regression. stream handler is already processing chunks; we’re just checking first chunk.

Chloe Martin: ship it. Jin — merge and start prod canary.

DeployBot: PR merged by Chloe Martin

DeployBot: prod canary deploy started (5%)

Logan Wright: I’ll monitor schema failures + event volume. expecting `first_streaming_success` to drop meaningfully.

SentryBot: Analytics schema validation warnings back to baseline (last 15m)

DeployBot: prod rollout complete (100%)

Jada Williams: thanks all. action items:
- Logan: please note deploy time for data annotation
- Paula: I’ll send you the exact window + suggest excluding streaming-success metric pre-fix
- Leila: can you file a follow-up to add an e2e test in the onboarding harness?

Logan Wright: deploy complete at 14:42 PT. bad data window: ~yesterday 10:15 PT -> today 14:42 PT. I’ll drop a note in the analytics channel + add an annotation to the activation dashboard.

Paula Mendes: perfect. I’ll sync with Sana/Mei.

Leila Farouk: follow-up ticket filed: “Add e2e coverage for streaming success trigger + required props”

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: thanks for moving quickly. please keep an eye on any unexpected support spikes — canceling streams is common, so this was likely inflating activation.

Jada Williams: yep. closing the loop in #product now.
